mapper.sql: s.PRIMARY_ID as session_ref, s.SESSION_ID as session_id, cast(s.PRINCIPAL_NAME as bigint) as user_id, s.CREATION_TIME as creation_time, s.LAST_ACCESS_TIME as last_access_time, s.EXPIRY_TIME as expiry_time, u.email, u.display_name, coalesce(u.status, 'DELETED') as user_status
mapper.select: select from SPRING_SESSION s left join auth_users u on u.id = cast(s.PRINCIPAL_NAME as bigint) where order by s.LAST_ACCESS_TIME desc, s.PRIMARY_ID asc limit #{query.pageSize} offset #{query.offset}
select count(*) from SPRING_SESSION s left join auth_users u on u.id = cast(s.PRINCIPAL_NAME as bigint) where

select count(*) as valid_session_count, count(*) filter (where LAST_ACCESS_TIME >= #{activeSinceEpochMillis}) as active_session_count, count(distinct PRINCIPAL_NAME) as valid_user_count from SPRING_SESSION where PRINCIPAL_NAME ~ '^[0-9]+$' and EXPIRY_TIME > #{nowEpochMillis}
